caption:
Longing for the day God sets everything right? For some, that light is darkness. (Amos 5:18 devotional)

The day you long for is light only if you're found in Him, not just for you. In Christ, that day is the day you need not fear.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Do I assume God's great day will simply take my side — no matter how I've lived?
